summary: Greece publishes unusually detailed official Golden Visa statistics: the Ministry of Migration and Asylum's monthly "Legal Migration" bulletins (with Annex B tables, 2022 onwards) give valid permits (main investors vs family, initial vs renewal, by nationality), applications by filing year with outcomes, permits issued by decision month and pending files; spreadsheets give investor permit stocks back to 2016. There are no official figures on investment value; the widely quoted amounts (e.g. EUR 2.32bn in 2024) are application counts multiplied by the minimum threshold. Program terms are well documented in legislation and circulars (EUR 250k 2013; EUR 500k zones Dec 2022; EUR 800k/400k/250k from Sept 2024).

sources.publisher: Υπουργείο Μετανάστευσης και Ασύλου (Ministry of Migration and Asylum)
sources.covers: Section 4 "Μόνιμη Άδεια Διαμονής Επενδυτή" (Golden Visa): valid permits at end of month (investors and family members, first grant vs renewal), applications by year of filing, permits issued by month, pending applications.

sources.title: Νόμιμη Μετανάστευση Δεκέμβριος 2022 - Παράρτημα Β (Legal Migration, Δεκέμβριος 2022, Annex B tables)
sources.publisher: Υπουργείο Μετανάστευσης και Ασύλου (Ministry of Migration and Asylum)
sources.covers: Tables 12a/12b (valid investor / family-member permits by nationality and sex), 13a/13b (applications by year/month of filing and their outcome), 14/15 (permits issued by month of filing / month of decision), 16/17 (pending applications).
sources.notes: Tables under Law 4251/2014 "Μόνιμη άδεια διαμονής επενδυτή" (now art. 100 Law 5038/2023, permit type B.5). Counts are permits (one per person). Application-year tables are revised in every monthly edition as pending files are decided and data are cleaned, so the same filing year shows different totals in different editions.

sources.title: ΣΤΑΤΙΣΤΙΚΑ_ΑΔ_20161231 (valid residence permits of third-country nationals, 31.12.2016, spreadsheet)
sources.publisher: Υπουργείο Μετανάστευσης και Ασύλου (Ministry of Migration and Asylum)
sources.covers: All valid residence permits on 31.12.2016 by issuing office, nationality, permit type, sex, age. Pivot sheet by type and sex includes investor permanent residence permits.
sources.notes: Downloaded as .zip, stored as the single .xls it contains. Investor permits appear as one permit type ("ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΗΣ-ΜΟΝΙΜΗ ΔΙΑΜΟΝΗ" / "ΜΟΝΙΜΗ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΔΙΑΜΟΝΗΣ ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΗ (Ν4251/14)"); family members of investors are NOT separately identified (they appear to be included in general family-member types), so these counts are best read as main investors only. Not directly comparable with the 2022+ bulletins, which report family members of investors separately.

observations.quote: a record-breaking 9,289 applications were submitted for residence permits under Greece's Golden Visa program
observations.notes: Attributed to the Ministry; matches the Dec 2024 Annex B figure for initial main-investor applications (later revised to 9,391 and 9,372).

observations.quote: representing real estate investments totaling at least 2.32 billion euros
observations.notes: Not an official measured value: no ministry table reports investment amounts. The figure equals 9,289 applications x EUR 250,000 (the old minimum), i.e. a theoretical floor, which is also wrong for applications under the EUR 500,000 zones. Treat as a claim.

observations.quote: 4,536 permits granted in 2024, up from 4,231 in 2023
observations.notes: Attributed by GTP to Astons (migration agency), not the Ministry. Definition unclear; the Ministry's 13-month table (Dec 2023-Dec 2024) shows 4,885 initial permits issued, and the Dec 2024 edition shows 1,617 issued among applications filed in 2024.
Attributed to Astons; matches the Ministry Dec 2024 figure for pending INITIAL main-investor applications (Πίνακας 13a/16), not all pending files (15,420 main incl. renewals; 49,301 incl. family).

observations.quote: bringing the 2021 annual total to 1,035 approvals
observations.notes: Derived from monthly increments of a cumulative official count (probably Enterprise Greece). Much lower than the Ministry's later count of 1,900-1,910 issued among initial applications filed in 2021 (by filing year, including decisions taken after 2021) - different definitions (decision year vs filing year) and vintages.

observations.quote: the number of approved dependents rose markedly, from 1,971 in 2020 to 3,383 in 2021
observations.notes: Family members (dependants) approved in 2021, derived from cumulative counts.

observations.quote: το Υπουργείο Εξωτερικών εξέδωσε 8.011 άδειες διαμονής για τους ίδιους τους επενδυτές ακινήτων
observations.notes: Translation: "the Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued 8,011 residence permits for the real-estate investors themselves" (2014 to July 2020). Footnote cites Enterprise Greece data dated 05.01.2021 and says they are VALID permits drawn from the Ministry of Migration database, contradicting the "issued" wording. Attribution to the Foreign Ministry is likely an error.

observations.quote: και πάνω από 23.758 για τα μέλη των οικογενειών τους
observations.notes: Translation: "and over 23,758 for their family members". Same caveats as the 8,011 figure. Ratio ~3 family permits per investor is far above the ~2 in 2022+ Ministry stocks; unexplained.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor (family members included); all of Greece
program_terms.quote: εφόσον το ελάχιστο ύψος του ακινήτου ανέρχεται σε διακόσιες πενήντα χιλιάδες (250.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "provided the minimum value of the property amounts to 250,000 euros". Introduced by art. 6(2) Law 4146/2013 (ΦΕΚ Α 90/18.4.2013) as art. 36A Law 3386/2005; later codified in art. 20(B) Law 4251/2014. Several properties could be combined (circular 13, point A1.4). Circular 15/2013 also accepted older purchases whose current objective value reached EUR 250,000. valid_to is when Law 5007/2022 was published; the EUR 250,000 level continued outside the high-demand zones (see next rows).

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; lease of at least 10 years of hotel accommodation or furnished tourist residences
program_terms.quote: εφόσον το ελάχιστο ύψος της μίσθωσης ανέρχεται σε διακόσιες πενήντα χιλιάδες (250.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "provided the minimum value of the lease amounts to 250,000 euros" (at least ten-year lease in complex tourist accommodation, art. 8(2) Law 4002/2011).

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; single property; North, Central and South Athens regional units, Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni, Municipality of Thessaloniki, Mykonos and Santorini
program_terms.notes: Translation: "is set at five hundred thousand (500,000) euros". Transitional (art. 92): EUR 250,000 purchases in these zones could still be completed by 30.4.2024 if a 10% deposit/preliminary contract was in place by 31.7.2023. Re-enacted unchanged in art. 100(2)(a) Law 5038/2023 (from 1.4.2023). valid_to = end of the Law 5100/2024 transitional deadline for deposits.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; one or more properties; all other areas
program_terms.quote: καθορίζεται σε διακόσιες πενήντα χιλιάδες (250.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "is set at two hundred fifty thousand (250,000) euros" for "the other areas of the country". Same in art. 100(2)(b) Law 5038/2023.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; single property of at least 120 m2 main floor area; Attica region, Thessaloniki regional unit, Mykonos, Thira and islands over 3,100 inhabitants
program_terms.notes: Translation: "are set at eight hundred thousand (800,000) euros". Law 5100/2024 published 5.4.2024; old rules still available if a 10% deposit/contract was in place by 31.8.2024, with completion by 28.2.2025 (extended by Law 5167/2024). valid_from therefore marks the end of the deposit window, not the law date. Applies also to co-owned shares and tourist leases.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; single property of at least 120 m2; all other areas
program_terms.notes: Translation: "are set at four hundred thousand (400,000) euros". Same transitional rules as the EUR 800,000 row.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; single property whose use is changed from commercial/industrial to residential before application; anywhere
program_terms.quote: η ελάχιστη αξία κτήσης αυτής κατά τον χρόνο απόκτησής της καθορίζεται σε διακόσιες πενήντα χιλιάδες (250.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "its minimum acquisition value at the time of acquisition is set at 250,000 euros". Such properties may not be used as company seat; fines under para 7A.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; single listed (protected) building to be restored; anywhere
program_terms.quote: η ελάχιστη αξία κτήσης της κατά τον χρόνο απόκτησής της καθορίζεται σε διακόσιες πενήντα χιλιάδες (250.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "its minimum acquisition value ... is set at 250,000 euros". Restoration must be completed before first renewal; EUR 150,000 fine otherwise.

program_terms.applies_to: Greek government bonds, residual maturity at least 3 years
program_terms.quote: αγορά ομολόγων του ελληνικού δημοσίου, με αξία κτήσης πεντακοσίων χιλιάδων (500.000) ευρώ τουλάχιστον
program_terms.notes: Translation: "purchase of Greek government bonds with acquisition value of at least 500,000 euros". Separate permit type B.4 under art. 99 Law 5038/2023 ("Χρηματοοικονομικές επενδύσεις"), granted by the Minister on the proposal of the Directorate for FDI; commonly marketed as Golden Visa routes but NOT counted in the Ministry's "Μόνιμη άδεια διαμονής επενδυτή" (art. 100 / Law 4251/14 art. 20B) statistics as far as the table titles show. Pre-2023 levels under art. 16 Law 4251/2014 (as amended by Law 4605/2019) not verified from legislation (see rows sourced to TI Greece).

events.title: Greece creates five-year residence permit for property owners (EUR 250,000)
events.description: Law 4146/2013 (ΦΕΚ Α 90, 18.4.2013), art. 6(2), adds art. 36A to Law 3386/2005: five-year renewable residence for third-country nationals owning or intending to buy property of at least EUR 250,000, and their families. Date is the Gazette issue date as cited in circulars.
events.quote: στο ΦΕΚ 90 Α΄ δημοσιεύτηκε ο ν. 4146/2013 «Διαμόρφωση Φιλικού Αναπτυξιακού Περιβάλλοντος για τις Στρατηγικές και Ιδιωτικές Επενδύσεις και άλλες διατάξεις»

events.title: Older purchases qualify on current objective value
events.description: Interior Ministry circular 15/2013 allows properties bought before the law, at below EUR 250,000, to qualify if current objective value is at least EUR 250,000.
events.quote: Η άδεια διαμονής χορηγείται και σε περιπτώσεις που το τίμημα που είχε καταβληθεί κατά την αγορά του ακινήτου, ήταν μικρότερο των διακοσίων πενήντα (250.000) χιλιάδων ευρώ

events.title: European Commission report flags risks of golden visa schemes, incl. Greece
events.description: COM(2019) 12 lists Greece among the Member States with investor residence schemes (real estate model, renting possible) and states such schemes raise security, money laundering, tax evasion and corruption risks.
events.quote: Such schemes have raised concerns about certain inherent risks, in particular as regards security, money laundering, tax evasion and corruption.

events.title: Minimum raised to EUR 500,000 in parts of Athens, Thessaloniki, Mykonos, Santorini
events.description: Law 5007/2022 (ΦΕΚ Α 241/23.12.2022) art. 91 sets EUR 500,000 (single property) in high-demand areas; EUR 250,000 elsewhere. Art. 92 lets deals with a deposit by 31.7.2023 be completed at EUR 250,000 until 30.4.2024.

events.title: New Migration Code: Golden Visa becomes art. 100 (permit type B.5)
events.description: Law 5038/2023 (ΦΕΚ Α 81/1.4.2023) re-enacts the real-estate permit as art. 100 and financial-investment permits (type B.4) as art. 99 with EUR 350,000-800,000 minimums.
events.quote: Επενδύσεις σε ακίνητη περιουσία (μόνιμη άδεια διαμονής επενδυτή) (άδεια διαμονής «Τύπου Β.5»)

events.title: Law 5100/2024: EUR 800,000 / EUR 400,000 thresholds, EUR 250,000 only for conversions and listed buildings
events.description: Art. 64 Law 5100/2024 (ΦΕΚ Α 49/5.4.2024) replaces art. 100: EUR 800,000 in Attica, Thessaloniki regional unit, Mykonos, Thira and islands >3,100 inhabitants; EUR 400,000 elsewhere; single property of at least 120 m2; transitional deposit deadline 31.8.2024.

events.title: Short-term rental of Golden Visa properties banned; EUR 50,000 fine
events.description: Law 5100/2024 adds art. 100(7A): properties used for Golden Visa may not be let short-term or sublet; permit revoked and EUR 50,000 fine on breach.
events.quote: απαγορεύεται να εκμισθώνονται βραχυχρόνια στο πλαίσιο της οικονομίας του διαμοιρασμού

events.title: Deadline to complete old-rule purchases extended to 28 Feb 2025
events.description: Law 5167/2024 (ΦΕΚ Α 207/20.12.2024) art. 37(1) extends the transitional completion deadline in art. 64(4) Law 5100/2024 to 28.2.2025 (per the consolidator's note).
events.quote: παρατάθηκε μέχρι την 28η Φεβρουαρίου 2025 με την παράγραφο 1 του άρθρου 37 του ν. 5167/2024

events.title: Portugal stops new golden visa applications for real estate and capital transfer
events.description: Lei 56/2023 (Mais Habitação), published 6.10.2023 and in force the next day, bars new investment-residence (ARI) applications under art. 3(1)(d)(i), (iii) and (iv) of Law 23/2007 (capital transfer and real-estate routes); renewals of existing permits remain possible.
events.quote: Não são admitidos novos pedidos de autorização de residência para atividade de investimento, concedidos ao abrigo do disposto nas subalíneas i), iii) e iv)

events.title: Spain abolishes investor visas (golden visa)
events.description: Ley Orgánica 1/2025 (BOE 3.1.2025) empties arts. 63-67 of Ley 14/2013 (investor visas/permits); in force three months after publication, i.e. 3 April 2025; existing permits may be renewed.
events.location: p. 261, disposición final vigesimoprimera; p. 272, disposición final trigésima octava
events.quote: Uno. Se dejan sin contenido los artículos 63, 64, 65, 66 y 67.

events.title: Spanish government announces end of golden visas from 3 April 2025
events.description: Press release: end of residence permits linked to real-estate investment over EUR 500,000 and of all investor residence visas.
events.quote: El Gobierno de España pone fin este jueves 3 de abril a la concesión de permisos de residencia vinculados a inversiones inmobiliarias de más de 500.000 euros

programs.name: Greece Golden Visa (Μόνιμη άδεια διαμονής επενδυτή - permanent investor residence permit, real estate)
programs.notes: Residence (not citizenship): five-year renewable permit, no right to work, no minimum stay; family members get derivative permits. Legal basis: art. 36A Law 3386/2005 (added by Law 4146/2013) -> art. 20(B) Law 4251/2014 -> art. 100 Law 5038/2023 (type B.5). Financial-investment permits (art. 16 Law 4251/2014 / art. 99 Law 5038/2023, type B.4) are a separate permit type. Ministry statistics count permits (one per person) and distinguish main investors vs family members and first grant vs renewal.

new_indicators.name: Valid investor-linked residence permits, all holders (stock)
new_indicators.definition: Residence permits valid on a date held by main investors AND their family members, first grants plus renewals
new_indicators.notes: Stock at a date. One permit per person, so approximates persons holding the status.

new_indicators.name: Valid residence permits of main investors (stock)
new_indicators.definition: Valid permits held by main investors (first grant plus renewal), excluding family members
new_indicators.notes: Closest proxy for the number of investors holding the status on a date.

new_indicators.name: Valid first-grant permits of main investors (stock)
new_indicators.definition: Valid permits of main investors still in their first (initial) permit period

new_indicators.name: Valid renewed permits of main investors (stock)
new_indicators.definition: Valid permits of main investors that have been renewed or reissued

new_indicators.name: Valid first-grant permits of investors' family members (stock)
new_indicators.definition: Valid initial permits held by family members of investors

new_indicators.name: Valid renewed permits of investors' family members (stock)
new_indicators.definition: Valid renewed/reissued permits held by family members of investors

new_indicators.name: Valid first-grant main-investor permits held by Chinese nationals
new_indicators.definition: investor_permits_valid_initial restricted to nationals of China
new_indicators.notes: Nationality breakdowns as separate indicators so they do not collide with totals.

new_indicators.name: Valid first-grant main-investor permits held by Turkish nationals
new_indicators.definition: investor_permits_valid_initial restricted to nationals of Turkey

new_indicators.name: Dependants approved
new_indicators.definition: Family members (dependants) granted residence or citizenship derived from a main applicant, in a period

new_indicators.name: Applications pending, incl. family members
new_indicators.definition: Applications of main applicants and family members filed but not yet decided at a date

new_indicators.name: Applications pending
new_indicators.definition: Applications of main applicants (initial and renewal unless noted) filed but not yet decided at a date
